evals.prompt: The normative Ikemen manifest pins revision A, but recent runtime tickets and reports cite revision B. Decide what can be claimed and what work comes next.
evals.expected_output: A source-pin delta and semantic review gate separate current evidence from blocked candidate-based claims.
assertions: The response identifies the normative and candidate pins separately.
It diffs claim-relevant upstream files or symbols instead of trusting release notes.
It requires rerun against the normative pin or explicit candidate promotion.
It keeps broad compatibility claims blocked while semantic review is open.

evals.prompt: Twenty focused runtime cuts pass, the last global test/trace checkpoint predates them, and the newest backlog entry belongs to Studio. Audit readiness for a score update.
evals.expected_output: Separate runtime, Studio, focused, and global cursors expose the stale global gate and prevent score movement until it reruns.
assertions: The response does not treat the newest overall backlog entry as runtime authority.
It records focused and global checkpoints as separate evidence rows.
It requires the global checkpoint before broad score movement.
It keeps docs-only or Studio work from moving runtime scores.

evals.prompt: Studio GateEvidence says passed and the trace corpus is green, but neither record names the current commit or input digest. Choose the next gate and handoff verdict.
evals.expected_output: Unidentified evidence is unknown, the matrix names missing subjects, and the next gate regenerates evidence against the current code and inputs.
assertions: A passed label without subject identity is classified unknown.
The response asks for commit, input/corpus digest, producer command, and result.
Studio/browser and trace evidence remain separate lanes.
The handoff states allowed and blocked claims plus one next proof slice.

evals.prompt: The MUGEN roadmap generator reports closedThrough DA30-025. Three tasks only prove green command exits, a loaded Play canvas, and loaded Studio shells; their written semantic clauses and negative cases have no manifests. Audit the watermark and define the repair gate.
evals.expected_output: Recorded and adjudicated cursors split, generic observations stay narrow, and clause manifests plus semantic reruns gate any accepted status or score claim.
assertions: The response keeps machine-recorded and adjudicated watermarks separate.
It classifies command exits, canvas load, and shell load as narrow observations rather than task completion.
It requires versioned clause manifests with semantic assertions, negative cases, revision identity, and claim ceilings.
It names Play state changes, real Studio save/reopen/recovery, and complete formal output as repair evidence.
It blocks score movement and consecutive advancement until written clauses pass.
